title: Gastric Per-Oral Endoscopic Myotomy (G-POEM) for the Treatment of Gastroparesis
official: Gastric Per-Oral Endoscopic Myotomy (G-POEM) for the Treatment of Gastroparesis: A Database Repository
summary: Gastric Per-Oral Endoscopic Myotomy (G-POEM) is a procedure for the Treatment of Gastroparesis.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age
* Referral for endoscopic treatment of Gastroparesis for symptom management

Exclusion Criteria:

* \< 18 years of age
* Absence of gastroparesis based on scintigraphy studies
